description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractMongoSnapshotAdapter, which provides a MongoDB-specific implementation of SnapshotAdapter for Jsonifiable objects. It includes methods for converting snapshot entities to and from JSON representations suitable for persistence, and handles interactions with BSON and JSON formats. The class is intended to be subclassed for specific entity types.

classes.name: AbstractMongoSnapshotAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class providing MongoDB-specific snapshot handling for Jsonifiable objects, including conversion to/from JSON and BSON formats. To be extended for specific entity types.

methods.name: toSnapshotStore
methods.description: Converts a snapshot entity into a storage-compatible object by serializing it to JSON and then to a BSON-compatible format.

methods.name: fromSnapshotStore (SnapshotOffer)
methods.description: Reconstructs a snapshot entity from an Akka SnapshotOffer object.

methods.name: fromSnapshotStore (SelectedSnapshot)
methods.description: Reconstructs a snapshot entity from an Akka SelectedSnapshot object.

methods.name: convertToJson
methods.description: Converts a snapshot entity to its JSON representation.

methods.name: convertSnapshotToJsonifiable
methods.description: Attempts to convert a raw snapshot object to a Jsonifiable entity.

methods.name: convertSnapshotEntityToJson
methods.description: Converts a raw snapshot object, expected to be a BsonValue, into a JsonObject.

methods.name: convertToJson (BsonValue)
methods.description: Serializes a BsonValue to a JsonObject.

methods.name: tryToCreateJsonifiableFrom
methods.description: Attempts to create a Jsonifiable object from a JsonObject, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: createJsonifiableFrom
methods.description: Abstract method to create a Jsonifiable entity from a JsonObject, to be implemented by subclasses.
